title: Feed source manifest v1
description: One file per data source in platform/data/sources/<id>.yaml. See docs/architecture/feed-platform.md section 3.1. The file name (without .yaml) must equal id. Credentials are names only, never values.

id.description: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Also the feed-control KV key and the stream id. Must equal the file name.

subject.description: NATS subject pattern the source publishes to. Must start with a locked grammar prefix (evt.world., intel., tel., det.). ent.* and tak.* are not allowed: only the entity service writes ent.*, only the TAK projector builds CoT.

interval.description: Default poll interval. The feed-control KV can override it live.

rate_limit.description: What the upstream allows. The runner must stay under it.

credentials.description: Names of Secret keys the source needs. Never values.

key.description: Environment variable name the stream reads as ${KEY}.

fallback.description: Id of another source to switch on if this one fails.

default_enabled.description: Used only when the feed-control KV has no entry for this id yet.

mapper.description: One or two plain sentences on how a record becomes an observation.

stream.description: Full Redpanda Connect stream config (input, pipeline, output). Use the literal __INTERVAL__ where the poll interval goes; the controller replaces it.

ingest_ref.description: Entry name in the omos-ingest sources file.
